profile_text.body:
IBM is a public company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY, USA, with a ticker of IBM and a CIK of 0000051143. Its most recent revenue filing, a 10-K for the period ending 2025-12-31, reported $67,535,000,000. The company's site describes IBM OpenPages as a scalable, AI-powered governance, risk, and compliance platform that can run on any cloud or on premises, with modular components for risk, compliance, and audit functions. The site says OpenPages includes a GRC Canvas workspace for modeling processes, risks, and controls with live data, and that it can integrate watsonx.ai or other models through an API-based architecture. IBM also describes an OpenPages MCP Server that lets AI agents create, query, and update GRC objects.

The site lists IBM watsonx.governance for AI lifecycle governance, including model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation, along with EU AI Act accelerators, and states it was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026. IBM watsonx is described as an enterprise AI platform with model-agnostic governance features covering agent inventory, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection. The site also cites recognition as a leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment, and describes a partnership with Citi to automate internal audit work using AI and machine learning.

IBM's recorded litigation exposure is in New York, with a count of 459.
